SWKS.thesis_one_line: Phone-and-car radio chip maker merging with Qorvo; strong recent beats, but price already assumes most promised cost savings arrive.
key_adverse_facts: Apple was 67% of FY25 net revenue (10-K)
GAAP operating margin fell from 17.0% (Dec 2024 qtr) to 5.2% (Jul 2026 qtr); FCF negative in two of last three quarters
Dividend eliminated in Jul 2026 release; $2.0B new notes issued 4 Aug 2026; pro forma net debt about $2.8B
Stock ($89.34) above Street mean target ($68.35) at 25 Sep close
data_conflicts: d4/Yahoo shows $2.84 dividend (4.1% yield) but dividends were discontinued (Q3 FY26 release)
Yahoo total debt $681M vs consolidated carrying debt $496.9M (leases likely)
Q3 FY26 release risk text cites a Silicon Laboratories transaction not found in the 10-Q
SWKS.confidence_in_thesis: low: merger closes about 5 Oct 2026 so reported history is not pro forma; synergy and Apple outcomes unknown

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row. Reverse DCF on pro forma SBC-adjusted earnings per share ($3.90 base, 9.5% discount rate) implies 7.9% a year versus my base 6.6% a year.

SWKS.scenario_basis: FY29 non-GAAP EPS 4.6/7.0/9.0 x 12/15/17 on $89.34; pro forma EPS before synergies about $5.31 (SBC-adjusted $3.90); no dividend (discontinued).
kill_criteria: Combined (or Skyworks standalone, if no close) quarterly revenue below $1,010M for the guided September 2026 quarter, or two consecutive quarters of y/y revenue decline after close.
Consolidated net debt/non-GAAP EBITDA above 2.5x at the first post-close balance sheet, or no net debt reduction within four quarters of close.
GAAP gross margin below 38% (Q3 FY26: 40.1%) for two consecutive quarters.
Apple above 60% of combined net revenue in the first full post-close 10-K.
Cumulative restructuring plus acquisition charges above $600M in the first 12 months post-close.

LEN.thesis_one_line: Big US homebuilder with low debt trading near book value, but cutting delivery targets, margins falling and burning cash as mortgage rates rise.
key_adverse_facts: Full-year delivery target cut from about 85,000 to 82-83k to 80-81k in FY26
Gross margin on home sales 15.8% vs 17.5% a year ago; orders -9%; incentives about 12%
Net homebuilding debt rose from $643M to $3,147M in nine months while $0.99B of stock was repurchased; operating cash flow negative (-$718M in six months)
FY27 consensus EPS cut about 20% in 90 days; 6 EPS misses in last 8 reports (d4)
Mortgage rate about 6.8% at quarter end and higher since (Q3 release)
data_conflicts: Yahoo total debt $6.0B includes Financial Services; homebuilding debt is $4.30B
Yahoo shares 210.5M (Class A only) vs about 241M implied
d4 NTM P/E flagged caution (FY0 +7% vs quarterly rows)
LEN.confidence_in_thesis: low-medium: balance sheet is sound but earnings direction and cash conversion are negative; cycle timing unknowable

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row. Reverse DCF on FY26 EPS $4.95 (10% discount rate) implies 4.6% a year versus my base 5.7%; still WATCH because the base 3-year return is only about 3% a year and estimates are falling.

LEN.scenario_basis: FY29 EPS 7.0 (base) x 12 plus about $6 dividends on $82.15; bear 0.65x book of $93 plus $6; bull EPS 11 x 12.5 plus $6; starting FY26 EPS $4.95, dividend $2.00 a year.
kill_criteria: Gross margin on home sales below 15.0% in any two consecutive quarters (Q3 FY26: 15.8%).
New orders below 19,500 in Q4 FY26 (low end of guide), or orders below deliveries by more than 10% for two consecutive quarters.
Homebuilding debt to total capital above 22% (Homebuilding segment, Supplemental Data table; 31 Aug 2026: 16.6%) or net homebuilding debt above $5.0B.
FY2027 delivery target below 78,000 homes when first given (FY26 target now 80,000-81,000).
Two consecutive quarters in which both gross margin and SG&A ratio miss the guided range.

PSKY.thesis_one_line: Media group borrowing heavily to buy Warner Bros. Discovery; shares only work if large cost savings arrive while TV advertising keeps shrinking.
key_adverse_facts: Pro forma net debt about $77B (derived) vs company 4.3x synergised target; about 6.9x before synergies
FY2026 free cash flow roughly zero after about $800M transformation costs (company: conversion of at least 10% before those costs)
TV Media revenue -9% and advertising -14% in Q2 2026; part of adjusted EBITDA growth is an accounting-basis benefit
Ellison family and RedBird hold 100% of voting stock; $46.7B of non-voting equity issued at a $12.00 floor price
$2.8B Netflix fee paid; $7.0B regulatory termination fee if the deal fails; consent decree divestiture triggers (Miramax, six cable channels)
data_conflicts: d4 free cash flow $17.6B vs filings H1 2026 FCF $354M
d4 average EPS surprise -99% not meaningful (predecessor/successor break)
30 Sep 2026 consent decree and 28 Sep 2026 $44.4B notes launch post-date the 25 Sep cutoff
PSKY.confidence_in_thesis: medium on REJECT: leverage and synergy dependence are filing-based; deal terms and warrant value could shift the numbers

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row. Pro forma equity of about $49.9B needs roughly 83% of the $6B synergy plan from day one versus my base of about 58% by 2029.

PSKY.scenario_basis: 2029 EBITDA $11.5B/$14.7B/$18.0B x 7/8/9 less year-3 net debt $77B/$69B/$64B over 5.0B pro forma shares, from $9.96; dividend ignored; warrants excluded.
kill_criteria: Consolidated net debt to LTM adjusted EBITDA above 6.0x at the first post-close quarter end (company target 4.3x synergised).
Consolidated free cash flow (OCF less capex) negative in any two consecutive post-close quarters.
Run-rate realised synergies below $2.0B twelve months after close (target over $6B).
Paramount+ paid subscribers below 80.0M for two consecutive quarters (81.6M at Q2 2026).
TV Media revenue decline worse than -12% y/y for two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: -9%).
